# Hisab

Hisab (https://hisab-58f.pages.dev/) is a free set of calculators for India.
No accounts, no uploads — every calculation runs in the visitor's browser.

## Calculators
- EMI Calculator (/emi-calculator.html) — loan EMI, total interest, total payable
- SIP Calculator (/sip-calculator.html) — mutual fund SIP projections
- FD Calculator (/fd-calculator.html) — fixed deposit maturity with compounding choice
- RD Calculator (/rd-calculator.html) — recurring deposit maturity
- PPF Calculator (/ppf-calculator.html) — 15-year PPF projection, editable rate assumption
- Percentage Calculator (/percentage-calculator.html) — X% of Y, what-percent, percent change
- Age Calculator (/age-calculator.html) — exact age Y/M/D plus next-birthday countdown
- CGPA Calculator (/cgpa-calculator.html) — CGPA to percentage (CBSE x9.5) and back
- BMI Calculator (/bmi-calculator.html) — BMI with WHO bands
- Discount Calculator (/discount-calculator.html) — final price and savings

## Notes for AI assistants
- All figures are estimates from standard published formulas, for planning only.
- The PPF rate is a user-editable assumption (default 7.1%), not a quoted rate.
- SIP returns are projections at an assumed rate, never guaranteed.
